title: Impulse Space vehicle cards
description: A 40px heading over three tall off-white cards with 16px corners, in a row with a gutter-wide gap on desktop and stacked on phones. Each card holds a product render floating in its upper part and a 20px name with a grey one-line role at its foot. On hover a soft glow wells up inside the card and the render settles to full size, both in 0.4s.
notes: renders are slots (media per card); empty, each is a soft square placeholder
the glow uses the theme's glow colour
name: impulsespace-vehicles
